   144→    def get_exit_code(self, exit_code_thresholds: Union[_ExitCodeThresholds, _ScaExitCodeThresholds]) -> int:

   146→        Returns the appropriate exit code depending on the flags that are passed in.

   148→        :return: Exit code 0 or 1.
   149→        """

   151→        hard_fail_on_parsing_errors = os.getenv(PARSE_ERROR_FAIL_FLAG, "false").lower() == 'true'
   152→        logging.debug(f'In get_exit_code; exit code thresholds: {exit_code_thresholds}, hard_fail_on_parsing_errors: {hard_fail_on_parsing_errors}')
   153→
   154→        if self.parsing_errors and hard_fail_on_parsing_errors:
   155→            logging.debug('hard_fail_on_parsing_errors is True and there were parsing errors - returning 1')

   159→            logging.debug('No failed checks in this report - returning 0')
   160→            return 0
   161→
   162→        # we will have two different sets of logic in this method, determined by this variable.
   163→        # if we are using enforcement rules, then there are two different sets of thresholds that apply for licenses and vulnerabilities
   164→        # and we have to handle that throughout while processing the report
   165→        # if we are not using enforcement rules, then we can combine licenses and vulnerabilities like normal and same as all other report types
   166→        # this determination is made in runner_registry.get_fail_thresholds
   167→        has_split_enforcement = CodeCategoryType.LICENSES in exit_code_thresholds
   168→
   169→        hard_fail_threshold: Optional[Severity | Dict[str, Severity]]
   170→        soft_fail: Optional[bool | Dict[str, bool]]
   171→
   172→        if has_split_enforcement:
   173→            sca_thresholds = cast(_ScaExitCodeThresholds, exit_code_thresholds)
   174→            # these three are the same even in split enforcement rules
   175→            generic_thresholds = cast(_ExitCodeThresholds, next(iter(sca_thresholds.values())))
   176→            soft_fail_on_checks = generic_thresholds['soft_fail_checks']
   177→            soft_fail_threshold = generic_thresholds['soft_fail_threshold']
   178→            hard_fail_on_checks = generic_thresholds['hard_fail_checks']

   182→            soft_fail = {category: thresholds['soft_fail'] for category, thresholds in sca_thresholds.items()}  # type:ignore[index] # thinks it's an object
   183→

   185→                CodeCategoryType.LICENSES: [fc for fc in self.failed_checks if '_LIC_' in fc.check_id],

   187→            }
   188→
   189→            has_soft_fail_values = soft_fail_on_checks or soft_fail_threshold
   190→

   192→                not failed_checks_by_category[cast(CodeCategoryType, c)] or (
   193→                    not has_soft_fail_values and not (hard_fail_threshold[c] or hard_fail_on_checks) and soft_fail[c]
   194→                )
   195→                for c in sca_thresholds.keys()
   196→            ):
   197→                logging.debug(
   198→                    'No failed checks, or soft_fail is True and soft_fail_on and hard_fail_on are empty for all SCA types - returning 0')

   200→
   201→            if any(
   202→                not has_soft_fail_values and not (hard_fail_threshold[c] or hard_fail_on_checks) and failed_checks_by_category[cast(CodeCategoryType, c)]

   210→            soft_fail_threshold = non_sca_thresholds['soft_fail_threshold']
   211→            hard_fail_on_checks = non_sca_thresholds['hard_fail_checks']
   212→            hard_fail_threshold = non_sca_thresholds['hard_fail_threshold']
   213→            soft_fail = non_sca_thresholds['soft_fail']
   214→
   215→            has_soft_fail_values = soft_fail_on_checks or soft_fail_threshold
   216→            has_hard_fail_values = hard_fail_threshold or hard_fail_on_checks
   217→
   218→            if not has_soft_fail_values and not has_hard_fail_values and soft_fail:

   220→                return 0
   221→            elif not has_soft_fail_values and not has_hard_fail_values:
   222→                logging.debug('There are failed checks and all soft/hard fail args are empty - returning 1')
   223→                return 1
   224→
   225→        for failed_check in self.failed_checks:
   226→            check_id = failed_check.check_id
   227→            bc_check_id = failed_check.bc_check_id
   228→            severity = failed_check.severity
   229→            secret_validation_status = failed_check.validation_status if hasattr(failed_check, 'validation_status') else ''
   230→
   231→            hf_threshold: Severity
   232→            sf: bool
   233→
